name: Toyotomi Hideyoshi
source:
"I want to you see you— that's the reason why I fight."

He is warm and caring and can soften any atmosphere. The sad face he suddenly shows— What are his true feelings behind his kindness?

Temperament: Humorous mood-maker
Likes: Bekko ame
